themes.label: Data Sovereignty & Offline-First
themes.description: Users demand local data storage, offline access, and full data portability. Connectivity dependency is a churn trigger, not a feature gap.
themes.anti_theme: Cloud-native real-time sync as default; local storage as optional add-on

themes.label: Judgment Bottleneck at Scale
themes.description: AI-accelerated production has created a decision backlog. Teams with 15+ candidates cannot allocate resources effectively using spreadsheets and intuition.
themes.anti_theme: Build speed is still the bottleneck; teams need faster prototyping, not better filtering

themes.label: Kill Decision Accountability
themes.description: PMs need evidence-based kill justification to survive executive scrutiny. 'Gut feeling' is politically indefensible; clause-level reasoning provides organizational cover.
themes.anti_theme: Kill decisions are intuitive and fast; formal reasoning slows teams down

themes.label: Anti-Engagement: Focus Over Noise
themes.description: Engagement-maximizing patterns (notifications, social feeds, gamification, unsolicited AI) are anti-correlated with retention in the focus-oriented segment. These features actively harm the product.
themes.anti_theme: Engagement features drive retention and monetization; passive users churn

themes.label: Team Collaboration & Shared Decisions
themes.description: Multi-PM teams need shared visibility into build/kill decisions. Solo features don't scale. Real-time collaboration and role-based access are required for teams >3.
themes.anti_theme: Product decisions are individual; each PM maintains their own view and prioritization

themes.label: Builder Handoff & Execution Pipeline
themes.description: Decisions alone are insufficient. Build candidates must flow into execution packets with UI/data/workflow specs and coding agent task breakdowns. Users want Cursor/Linear integration.
themes.anti_theme: Judgment tools should stop at the decision; execution is a separate tool's job

themes.label: Constitution Usability & Trust
themes.description: Constitution is the core differentiator but also the biggest onboarding barrier. Writing 3 lines takes 45 min. Normalization errors destroy trust. Parser accuracy is existential.
themes.anti_theme: Constitution is easy and intuitive; users naturally express their product policy in 3 lines
